notes.title: 🎉 Vampirates Release Date Revealed! 🧛‍☠️
notes.notes:
[p]That’s right, the moment has arrived! We’re thrilled to officially announce the release date for [b]Vampirates[/b]!
[/p][p]🦦, drumroll please...[/p][p]🥁🎶🥁🎶🥁🎶[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Vampirates rises from the dead on July 4th at 2PM CEST![/b][/h3][p][/p][p]A huge thank you to everyone who shared feedback, played our demo, and supported us along the way, we couldn’t have done it without you! 💜[/p][p][strike]Well... technically we could’ve made the game without you… but let’s be honest, it wouldn’t have been nearly as awesome.[/strike][/p][p][/p][p]Mark your calendars! We’ll see you on [b]July 4th[/b] to hurl zombies (and Kevin) together![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45605636/019f7aa438438a8ad533aab66a819c1055720298.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Vampirates has sailed into the Steam Next Fest! June 9-16
notes.notes:
[b]Yes, we’re doing another fest. No, we haven’t slept.[/b]

First off, a huge thank you to everyone who joined us during the Zombies vs. Vampires Fest and shared their feedback, it truly helped shape our next steps.

We took your feedback to heart and have some exciting updates for you:
[list]
[*] 💡 [b]Lighting touch-up[/b], now you can actually see what’s trying to kill you.
[*] 🔫 [b]New weapons[/b], because diplomacy didn’t work.
[*] ⚖️ [b]Improved difficulty balancing[/b], but hey, maybe it was a skill issue after all.
[*] 🧭 [b]Clearer player feedback[/b], less mystery, same amount of danger.
[*] 🌐 [b]Networking enhancements and bug fixes[/b], now with 30% fewer accidental teleportations.
[*] 👿 [b]A brand-new enemy type[/b], good luck taking them down!
[/list]
Keep the feedback coming! We are excited to see what you think!

notes.title: 🦇 The Vampirates demo has risen from the depths! OUT NOW!
notes.notes:
[b]💀 Rally your crew, feed your almighty Otter God, and get ready to sacrifice your friend Kevin!
[/b]
Our cursed crew has been hard at work, and now you can finally play the demo of [b]Vampirates[/b]! Dive into the Wet Plank Tavern and get a glimpse of the mayhem that awaits. Hurl objects (Kevin), experiment with weapons scattered around (Kevin), and unleash your inner Vampirate (not Kevin). Let the madness begin!
